papers.title: Emotion Regulation Modulates Subsequent Control of Unwanted Memories.
papers.abstract: Emotion regulation and memory control are indispensable for well-being, yet their interplay remains poorly understood. In this preregistered electroencephalogram (EEG) study, we investigated how emotion regulation influences the subsequent control of negative memories. Participants learned object-aversive scene pairings and were then instructed to either naturally watch or actively reappraise the aversive scenes. They subsequently completed an EEG-based Think/No-Think (TNT) task, where they either retrieved or suppressed the retrieval of aversive scenes in response to Think or No-Think object cues while reporting any intrusions they experienced. Different from our initial hypothesis, preregistered analyses showed that during retrieval suppression, reappraised memories were associated with larger centro-parietal P300 than watched scenes. Consistently, in the post-TNT recall test, participants recalled more details and reported lower negative emotions related to these reappraised scenes than the watched scenes. These results suggest that cognitive reappraisal may preserve the episodic content of negative memories while lessening their emotional impact during recall. This finding holds significant clinical potential, as it could enable individuals to retain valuable information from adverse experiences without being overwhelmed by distress. Additionally, it may help address reduced memory specificity in affective disorders, offering a promising avenue for therapeutic intervention.
papers.summary: 本研究利用腦電圖（EEG）探討情緒調節如何影響對負面記憶的後續控制。參與者先學習物體與厭惡場景的配對，接著被指示自然觀看或主動進行認知重評。隨後參與者完成 Think/No-Think（TNT）任務，根據線索檢索或抑制對厭惡場景的記憶，並報告是否有侵入性思緒。與預期不同，研究發現在檢索抑制期間，經過重評的記憶引發了比自然觀看場景更大的中央頂區 P300 波幅。此外，後續的回憶測試顯示，參與者對重評場景回憶出更多細節，且相關的負面情緒較低，這表明認知重評可能在降低情感衝擊的同時，保留了負面記憶的細節內容。
papers.significance: 此研究結果具有重要的臨床應用潛力，揭示了認知重評策略能幫助個體在保留不良經歷資訊的同時，減少回憶時的痛苦情緒。這對於治療情感障礙中的記憶特異性缺失問題提供了新的介入途徑，有助於開發更有效的心理治療方法。

papers.title: Motor similarity sharpens affect representation by acting as an embodied prior during action observation.
papers.abstract: Social interaction requires inferring others' affect from body movements, yet how the observer's own motor repertoire shapes this process remains unclear. Here, we investigated whether motor similarity between observer and agent modulates affect decoding from whole-body movements in social interactions. Using motion capture to quantify individual motor similarity, combined with behavioral ratings and fMRI multivariate pattern analysis, we examined neural representations of affective valence across varying levels of affective intensity. Behaviorally, motorically dissimilar movements were perceived as more emotionally intense, possibly showing increased salience for unfamiliar kinematics. At the neural level, motor similarity attenuated responses in the inferior parietal lobule while enhancing affect decoding in the inferior frontal gyrus. Importantly, decoding accuracy in the inferior frontal gyrus peaked for motor-similar interactions with high affective intensity. Together, these findings suggest that motor similarity might function as an embodied prior that sharpens affective representations and supports affect understanding from movement. The results align with hierarchical predictive-coding accounts, highlighting how the observer's own body shapes social perception.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了觀察者自身的動作經驗如何調節從他人全身動作中解碼情緒的過程。透過動作捕捉、行為評分及功能性磁振造影（fMRI）分析，結果顯示雖然動作不相似的動作被感知為更具情緒強度，但動作相似性減緩了下頂葉小葉的反應，同時增強了下額回的情緒解碼準確度，且這種增強效應在動作相似且高情緒強度的情境下最為顯著。
papers.significance: 該研究揭示了動作相似性作為具身先驗，在動作觀察中能夠精細化情緒表徵並支持從動作中理解情緒，這一發現支持了層級預測編碼理論。其重要性在於突顯了觀察者自身的身體狀態如何塑造社會感知，為理解社交互動中的神經機制提供了重要證據。

papers.title: A method for estimating functional connectivity corrected for the effects of the local hemodynamic response and its application to the diagnosis of schizophrenia.
papers.abstract: Functional connectivity, an index that quantifies temporal correlations between activities in different brain regions, has attracted attention for its potential applications in the diagnosis and pathological understanding of psychiatric disorders. Functional connectivity is estimated from fMRI blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signals, which provide high spatial resolution. However, because the BOLD signal is an indirect measure of neural activity reflecting hemodynamic response, local variations in the hemodynamic response can hinder the accurate estimation of functional connectivity. Here, we proposed a method that corrects for the influence of the hemodynamic response in functional connectivity estimation by assuming that time lags observed in BOLD signal components originate from local variations in the hemodynamic response. By correcting the hemodynamic response while accounting for these time lags, which have a critical impact on functional connectivity that represents temporal correlations of signals, we achieved improved consistency across different sessions within the same subject (within-subject consistency). In addition, functional connectivity estimated by the proposed method outperformed conventional approaches in detecting patients with schizophrenia. These findings suggest that the proposed method enables reliable connectivity estimation and holds promise as a useful biomarker for psychiatric disorders.
papers.summary: 功能性連結性是量化不同腦區活動時間相關性的指標，雖然在精神疾病診斷中具有潛力，但 fMRI BOLD 信號易受局部血流動力學響應變化的干擾。本研究提出一種校正方法，假設 BOLD 信號中的時間滯後源於局部血流動力學響應的差異，並在考慮這些滯後的情況下進行校正。該方法不僅提高了個體內測量的一致性，在識別精神分裂症患者方面的準確率也優於傳統方法。
papers.significance: 此方法通過修正血流動力學響應的影響，解決了功能性連結性估計中的一個關鍵技術難題，提升了神經影像數據的可靠性。其在精神分裂症診斷中的優異表現，表明該技術有望成為精神疾病的客觀生物標誌物，對精準醫療和病理機制理解具有重要價值。

papers.title: Grasping at the organization of object knowledge: testing different object-related dimensions as organizational principles of ventral temporal cortex.
papers.abstract: In our daily lives we encounter a myriad of things with which we interact when navigating our environment. Mental representations of these things are computed and stored in our brains to be manipulated in support of cognition. Several proposals have been put forth on how such representations are organized in the brain - and specifically within ventral temporal cortex (VTC), which is thought to support object recognition. Some propose that the organization of mental representations tracks the animacy status of target stimuli in a continuous way: high-animacy stimuli (e.g., chimps) are represented farther from artifacts (e.g., hammers) than low-animacy stimuli (e.g., lobsters). Others emphasize the role of different dimensions in the organization of mental representations, including real-object size, shape, texture and material properties, and graspability. Here we used functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and multivariate approaches to test the role of these dimensions as organizing principles of object information in VTC. We show that pattern discriminability between different categories of objects does not seem to follow differences in animacy status in any continuous way. Moreover, graspability and haptic texture properties are better predictors of representational content within VTC than animacy and real-object size. Our results align with evidence that object processing depends on bidirectional functional coupling between parietal regions involved in manipulation and grasping and VTC regions involved in material/texture processing. This supports a multidimensional account of object representations in VTC, where action-relevant and haptic/material properties contribute strongly to representational structure, potentially through interactions with distal regions involved in object-directed action.
papers.summary: 本研究利用功能性磁振造影（fMRI）探討腹側顳葉皮層（VTC）中物體知識的組織原則，並測試生機性、實際大小、形狀、質地及可抓握性等不同維度的影響。結果顯示，VTC內的表徵模式並未依據連續的生機性差異進行組織，相比之下，「可抓握性」和「觸覺質地」屬性是預測VTC表徵內容的更佳指標。
papers.significance: 該研究結果支持了VTC物體表徵的多維度觀點，證實動作相關屬性（如抓握）與觸覺材料屬性在大腦物體處理中佔有核心地位。這強調了涉及操作與抓握的頂葉區域與VTC之間的雙向功能耦合，對理解大腦如何整合感覺與運動資訊以構建物體認知具有重要意義。

papers.title: Altered Resting-State Co-Activation Patterns in Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder.
papers.abstract: Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) has been associated with abnormal large-scale brain network dynamics, but its transient whole-brain co-activation states remain insufficiently characterized. Against this background, the current study investigated potential alterations in the dynamics of whole-brain co-activation pattern (CAP) in OCD. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data were parcellated using the Brainnetome 246 atlas and analyzed with a CAP framework. CAP states were identified with k-means clustering, and temporal fraction, persistence, counts, and transition probabilities were compared between OCD and healthy controls. Three recurrent CAP states were identified as the optimal clustering solution. CAP2 showed a distinct intermediate bipolar configuration, with positive weights mainly involving thalamic, inferior frontal, medial temporal, temporoparietal, and medial superior frontal regions and negative weights mainly involving auditory, primary sensorimotor and dorsal insular regions. Yeo-7 mapping further showed that CAP2 had positive weights in the default mode and negative weights in the somatomotor systems. Compared with healthy controls, patients with OCD showed increased CAP2 temporal fraction, persistence, and self-transition probability, together with reduced counts and reduced transition probabilities from CAP2 to both CAP1 and CAP3. These findings suggest that OCD is associated with reduced switching flexibility and an increased tendency to stay in a specific brain state configuration across time.
papers.summary: 本研究探討了強迫症（OCD）患者全腦共激活模式（CAP）的動力學變化。研究利用休息狀態功能性磁振造影數據識別出三種重現的CAP狀態，發現OCD患者在特定的CAP2狀態（涉及丘腦、額葉等區域正權重及感覺運動區域負權重）中表現出更高的時間分數、持續時間及自我轉換概率，同時狀態間切換次數減少。
papers.significance: 該研究揭示了強迫症患者大腦網絡動力學的核心異常，即大腦狀態切換靈活性的降低以及對特定神經配置的過度固著。這項發現為理解強迫症的神經病理機制提供了新的視角，並有助於未來開發針對大腦動態狀態的診斷標記或治療策略。

papers.title: Habenula as a neural mediator of inattentive traits and sustained attention variability: A 7-tesla magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.abstract: Sustained attention requires continuous engagement and is sensitive to individual differences in motivational processes. Variability in sustained attention is commonly observed across individuals and can manifest as fluctuations in attentional stability during prolonged tasks. Such variability may reflect inattentive traits associated with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), which are continuously distributed across the general population. The habenula is a subcortical structure involved in motivation- and reward-related regulation, yet its contribution to individual differences in sustained attention remains unclear. This study examined whether habenular morphology is associated with dimensional ADHD-related inattentive traits and reaction-time variability during sustained attention. In 151 healthy adults (excluding high ADHD symptoms), we assessed self-reported ADHD symptoms and autistic traits, and measured sustained attention using a computerized visual processing task. Habenula volumes were quantified using 7-Tesla MRI with a deep-learning-based segmentation pipeline. Mediation analyses tested whether self-reported inattention and RVP SD latency were statistically linked via TIV-normalized relative habenula volume, controlling for age, sex, education, and autistic traits. Inattention scores were positively associated with relative habenula volume, whereas hyperactivity-impulsivity showed no such relationship. Larger relative habenula volume was associated with greater reaction-time variability (standard deviation [SD] latency). AQ total score was not significantly associated with relative total habenula volume or RVP SD latency. Mediation analysis identified a significant indirect statistical association linking inattention and SD latency via relative total habenula volume (ACME = 0.044, p = 0.032), independent of autistic traits, even in the absence of a significant total effect. Larger relative total habenula volume was associated with an indirect statistical link between self-reported inattention and reaction-time variability during sustained attention.
papers.summary: 本研究利用7T MRI分析151名健康成年人，探討緞核體積、ADHD注意力不集中特質及持續注意力變異性的關聯。結果顯示，注意力不集中與相對緞核體積呈正相關，且較大的體積與更高的反應時間變異性相關。中介分析證實，緞核體積在注意力不集中與反應時間變異性之間發揮顯著的間接中介作用，且此關聯獨立於自閉症特質。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了緞核在調節個體持續注意力差異中的神經機制，將腦結構形態學與動機/獎賞處理及認知控制連結起來。這項發現支持了注意力不集中特質在一般人群中的連續分佈假設，並為理解ADHD病理生理學中的動機-認知交互作用提供了新的神經解剖學證據。
